description: This file implements a command-line utility for encrypting and decrypting firmware files for Buffalo devices using a custom header cryptographic method. It handles file input/output, key-based header transformation, and command-line argument parsing.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information and command-line options.

methods.name: crypt_header
methods.description: Performs header encryption or decryption by substituting characters based on provided keys.

methods.name: crypt_file
methods.description: Reads the input file, applies encryption or decryption, and writes the output file.

methods.name: check_params
methods.description: Validates that input and output filenames are specified.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that parses command-line arguments and orchestrates the encryption/decryption process.
